No. HCIYEST-32011/:L/2025-ESTT-11 SECTION-HCM/ ba / It is hereby
notified to all concerned that, as provided under Item No. 15 of Schedule-C of the IYanipur State
District Courts Service (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 2022, twenty-four (24) employees of the
District Courts, whose names are listed in AMiWEXURE-'I, are provisionally allowed to appear in
the Computer Typing Test to be held at the High Court Complex on 7th February 2€D26,- as
part of the scheme of examination for promotion to the post of Lower Division Assistant in
the District Courts of Manipur.
It is further informed that employees who are found eligible under the aforesaid Rules, but
whose names do not appear in ABWNEXURE–E, may submit their claim(s) in writing, along with
supporting documents, to the undersigned (either physically or via email at
recruitmentcell.hcm@gmail.com)on or before 27th January 2026 (4:©© P.M.) for verification
of eligibility. No claim shall be entertained after the expiry of the aforesaid period.
